children: BlossomHill Therapeutics reported a second-quarter 2026 net loss of $23.8 million, or $(8.75) per share, on June 30, 2026 cash and cash equivalents of $95.4 million and R&D expenses of $21.4 million. The company completed an upsized initial public offering in August 2026 raising approximately $168.3 million in gross proceeds and said the combined cash resources are expected to fund operations into Q2 2028. Management highlighted clinical progress for BH-30643, BH-30236 and preclinical data for BH-501284 plus regulatory and corporate milestones achieved in the quarter.
Net loss for Q2 2026: $23.8 million (basic and diluted loss per share: $8.75).
Research and development expenses for Q2 2026: $21.4 million (Q2 2025: $12.5 million).
General and administrative expenses for Q2 2026: $3.3 million (Q2 2025: $1.6 million).
Cash and cash equivalents as of June 30, 2026: $95.4 million; company completed an IPO in August 2026 raising approximately $168.3 million in gross proceeds.
Loss from operations for Q2 2026: $24.7 million; six-month net loss through June 30, 2026: $44.8 million.

BH-30643: Received FDA Fast Track designation for treatment of advanced or metastatic EGFR C797S-positive NSCLC; Phase 1/2 SOLARA trial presented at ASCO and IASLC showing a 45% objective response rate and 88% disease control rate in C797S patients.
BH-30236: Presented initial clinical safety and early anti-leukemic activity in relapsed/refractory AML and HR‑MDS at EHA; development includes monotherapy and combination cohorts with venetoclax.
BH-501284: Presented first preclinical data for the pseudo-irreversible pan-KRAS inhibitor at AACR 2026; IND-enabling work underway with an anticipated IND submission in Q1 2027.
Corporate and governance: Expanded board with appointments of Sheila Gujrathi, M.D., and John Schmid; completed an upsized IPO in August 2026 strengthening the balance sheet.
Planned development milestones: End-of-Phase 1 FDA meeting for BH-30643 in Q4 2026, anticipated pivotal Phase 2 dosing in Q1 2027 and multiple Phase 1 data updates through 2027.
